verdict.rationale: The California Secretary of State's bizfile portal is a government service for business filings, records search and certificate orders. It is not an AI agent or assistant that could act as an MCP client consuming tools from plugged-in servers, so this axis is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows it ships any MCP-client capability that would make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
